lines.en: Gita, did you hear? Joy told me that she got a new job.
lines.pt: Gita, você soube? A Joy me disse que arrumou um emprego novo.

lines.en: Really? She told me last week that she was looking for one.
lines.pt: Sério? Ela me disse semana passada que estava procurando um.

lines.en: Yes, she said that the company offered her a good salary.
lines.pt: Sim, ela disse que a empresa ofereceu a ela um bom salário.

lines.en: Wow. Did she tell you where the new office is?
lines.pt: Nossa. Ela contou onde fica o novo escritório?

lines.en: She said that it was downtown, and that the team was friendly.
lines.pt: Ela disse que fica no centro e que a equipe era simpática.

lines.en: That is nice. My boss told me that the company was hiring two more people.
lines.pt: Que bom. Meu chefe me disse que a empresa estava contratando mais duas pessoas.

lines.en: Really? He told me that the budget was small, so I did not believe him.
lines.pt: Sério? Ele me disse que o orçamento era pequeno, então não acreditei.

lines.en: He said that they needed a designer and a driver. You should apply!
lines.pt: Ele disse que precisavam de um designer e de um motorista. Você deveria se candidatar!

lines.en: Maybe. Joy told me that the interview was easy and that the manager was kind.
lines.pt: Talvez. A Joy me disse que a entrevista foi fácil e que a gerente era gentil.

lines.en: She also said that she felt nervous at first, but she smiled a lot.
lines.pt: Ela também disse que ficou nervosa no começo, mas sorriu bastante.

lines.en: Everybody feels nervous. I think I will send my CV tonight.
lines.pt: Todo mundo fica nervoso. Acho que vou mandar meu currículo hoje à noite.

facts.big: She told me that she got a job
facts.label: Contar o que alguém disse
facts.sub: Use said that ou told me that e o verbo no passado: She said that she liked it. Com told, diga a pessoa: told me.

facts.label: Disse que
facts.sub: Use said that + frase no passado: She said that she got a new job. O that é opcional na fala. Depois de said não use me: said me é erro.

facts.label: Me disse que
facts.sub: Use told + pessoa + that: She told me that she was looking. Com told você precisa dizer quem ouviu: me, him, us.

compare.ask: She told me that she got a job.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ela disse que arrumou um emprego” e o verbo volta ao passado.
compare.tip: Diga: “She told me that she liked the team.”
compare.us: Em inglês, também: She said that she got a job. Use told + pessoa (told me) ou said + that. Não use told sem pessoa.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: She told me that she got a job.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

group: Pergunta: What did Joy say?

extra90: Peça que inventem um objeto parecido com outra informação.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: She said that she got a job.
She told that she got a job.
items.why: We say She told me that… or She said that…

items.s: Told is followed by a person.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: She said that she got a job. → Verdadeiro (Past after said.)
She told that she got a job. → Falso (We say She told me that… or She said that…)
Told is followed by a person. → Verdadeiro (told me, told him.)

pages.title: A break room in Dallas · 1/3
paragraphs: It is lunchtime in Dallas. Eva and Boris sit in the break room. Their friend Joy has a new job. Everyone in the office talks about it. Boris heard the news from Joy. Eva wants to know more.

“Eva, did you hear? Joy told me that she got a new job.” says Boris. “Really? She told me last week that she was looking for one.” says Eva. “Yes, she said that the company offered her a good salary.” says Boris.
